caption: Premiere Pro nahi, After Effects nahi. Sirf Claude Code se aisi professional videos. Aaj main aapko poora setup, step by step dikhata hoon.
Pehle samjho ye kaam kaise karta hai. Claude Code ek AI hai jo code likhta hai, aur Remotion naam ka tool us code ko video mein badal deta hai.
Step one. GitHub par ek naya repo banao. Phir Claude Code app kholo, aur new session mein apna repo select karo.
Step two. Chat mein likho, setup chalao. Claude khud chaar tools install karega. Remotion animation ke liye, Whisper captions ke liye, free AI voice, aur sound effects.
Step three. Plus button dabao, apni reference video attach karo, aur likho, isi style mein is topic par video banao.
Step four. Ab Claude reference ko frame by frame dekhta hai. Style samajhta hai, script likhta hai, voice banata hai, aur har scene animate karta hai.
Step five. Kuch hi minute mein final video, voice, SFX aur music ke saath, seedha chat mein aa jaati hai. Download karo, aur post karo.
Ek pro tip. Har naye session mein setup apne aap ho jaata hai, toh baar baar install ki tension nahi.
Aise hi AI tools seekhne ke liye, follow karo. Milte hain agle video mein.
